This project attempts to address some of these barriers through bringing R&D resources/ideas from other industries to bear on this problem, technology de-risking, providing a better understanding of the process economic and environmental drivers. For this project, it is difficult to estimate the commercialization timelines but input from industry will needed to give some indications of what a realistic timeline might be. Nevertheless, because this industry is capital intensive, the timelines are typically longer. It should be noted that there are barriers and practical limitations related to applying US, especially contact US, in the pockets in commercial dryer sections, with significant engineering challenges and they warrant further evaluation. Financing for follow-on scale-up work would most likely come from private funding in the paper companies and equipment manufacturers, perhaps with government backing through the DOE loan guarantee program and the like.
